actual unix MMAP_SIZE branch and PRAGMA implementation; unchanged mandatory configuration verification

semantics.authority: Root retains a native directory. Physical audit.db/WAL/rollback/SHM names stay unchanged. The actual opened FD is matched to expected identity before any SQLite configure/read; retained VFS method/context/descriptor binding checked through SQLITE_FCNTL_FILE_POINTER
semantics.policy: all SQL, mapped accesses, checkpoint/index cleanup, C-file closes and VFS drop finish inside protected closure; no escaped Connection from production helper; no real cloud-provider qualification
semantics.publication: construct LiveClaimAuthority only from durable plain facts after successful close and restoration. A refused successful interval cannot drop a claim while mutation mutex is held. Consume releases exclusion after helper success
semantics.failureInjection: generic guard phase refusal uses real native restoration in Drop; audit seam refuses after real checked restoration. Neither simulates a failing kernel setter
semantics.growth: actual C write/truncate/index growth limits complement pre/post metadata gates; no audit/recovery eviction or permission repair; database xFetch absent, MMAP_SIZE returns zero, bounded SHM mapping remains separate
semantics.locks: Linux/macOS OFD database/index locks survive a foreign same-process ordinary descriptor close. Default POSIX negative oracle still reproduces its old lock-release behavior
semantics.crashOracle: parent independently owns exec POSIX reader and native audit writer. Reader pins sequence 1 before native claim/reserve commits WAL; both killed with asserted SIGKILL before reopen. Main-only/recovered sequences, events, fence, projection and no-resubmit assertions preserved. Barrier files outside state namespace; owned-child RAII
semantics.defaultSameProcess: not qualified; custom descriptor close can still release a foreign same-process default POSIX client lock
semantics.windows: AuditStore remains UnsupportedPlatform; GNU lint does not qualify MSVC/runtime
semantics.remaining: shared 512 MiB/4090-name admission, owner-handle admission/retention, native Linux/Windows/MSVC/provider/mount runtime and final noncooperating unlink race remain open
